paper_title: Weak nuclear decays deep-underground as a probe of axion dark matter
coupling_convention: 1/f_a in GeV^-1 (axion-gluon coupling, y-axis of Fig. 3)
notes: Paper constrains the CP-violating axion-gluon coupling via oscillating theta-term, presented on the (m_a, 1/f_a) plane (Fig. 3). Y-axis is 1/f_a in GeV^-1. Combined 40K EC-decay and 137Cs beta-decay recast excludes f_a below 1.0e14-3.2e10 GeV (2 sigma) for m_a in 3.0e-23-9.6e-20 eV, giving a slope-1 line 1/f_a proportional to m_a. Emitted two endpoints as 1/f_a in GeV^-1. Could alternatively be classified as AxionEDM/AxionMass (gluon coupling); hint suggested AxionCPV.
